candidate: Fixed existing 75% public reviews, 25% genre and keyword match. Nearest liked tags minus 0.6 times nearest disliked tags. No tuning.
primary: Average held-out ranking AUC, average four evidence orders within each viewer before bootstrap uncertainty.
highRisk: Public-review AUC <= 0.60 on training films only. Defined before scoring held-out answers.
loss: Individual material loss: more than 3 ranking points OR at least one fewer like among ten recommendations, averaged across orders.
decision: Consider promotion only if primary gain >= 0.5 points, the 95% paired interval excludes zero, top-ten likes do not fall, and the high-risk group shows no material mean loss. Fewer than eight high-risk viewers leaves their safety unresolved.
caution: Rules guide a decision; they are not brittle CI gates. Secondary checkpoints are descriptive. New cohort becomes used after this experiment.
implementationCorrection: Before inspecting new-viewer outcomes, fixed arithmetic order to reproduce the original candidate scores exactly. Discarded the unreviewed preliminary run; no candidate parameter changed.
